decision_reason: Isovar reconstructs a 29-aa protein context whose deletion junction agrees with the reference-plus-edit translation; independent RNA scans support the exact allele in ONT and short-read data from T1 and T2.
dna_only: The repetitive 12-nt deletion predicts loss of four glutamates, but DNA alone cannot establish which low-complexity transcript sequence is expressed.
interpretation: GTF3C5 is the strongest additional cross-platform indel: 117/128 ONT and 7/12 short-read alternate fragments support T1/T2, while assembly resolves the repetitive protein context used for ranking.
limitation: Direct audit counts measure exact allele-spanning fragments and are distinct from the pinned T1 ONT fragments used to assemble the ranked protein.
